methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: It is then clear that the plant has not formalized energy target in terms of energy performance indicator and baseline. All above energy targets are taken independently and intuitively.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy-management framework without a characterised EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This research provides an alternative energy management system model for any industry willing to implement EnMS as strategic plan and at operational level.

stage1.notes: Cement application, but EDIM is an EnMS strategic/operational framework; no EnPI/EnB variables, functional form, or construction method is characterised.
